answer: The nadir I would price into every new account is Inducted vintner licence with wine makers attestation: a licence makers renew after vintage audits, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. What makes this stick is that a licence makers renew after vintage audits cannot be faked in bulk — each proof is independent, and the vertex of independence is that one compromised proof endangers no other account. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the relic for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
